statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))) → (∀ q n : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → 1 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => ¬ Nat.Coprime k q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) ≤ (q.primeFactors.card:ℝ)*Real.log n) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 由 BMOR 的 ψ 界恢复 FR-7022 的全部模数
plain_statement.en: Recover the full FR-7022 modulus range from BMOR ψ

brief.zh: 模 4 的奇类补足 q=2；再用 FR-7023 控制偶数权重补足 q=1。其余模数直接换算误差。
brief.en: Add the two odd classes modulo four for q=2, then use FR-7023 on the even contribution for q=1. The other moduli use the explicit error directly.
